integrity: All distributional formulas, quantifiers, endpoint signs, and the single-crossing argument were reconstructed directly. The universal statement is proved analytically and does not rest on numerical enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only shape two in the negative-binomial family highlighted by the motivating paper; shapes three and above are not claimed.
The result proves condition L1 and left-loadedness, not the stronger condition L2.

The closest older negative-binomial comparison source was available only through its public abstract during the literature check, so an equivalent older formulation under different terminology remains possible.
title: Left-loadedness for the shape-two negative-binomial family
